verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Google Takeout offers a Calendar backup, so users can download their calendar data. However, nothing in the pack says which format the export uses or confirms it is open. One user also reports the export tool does not work for deactivated accounts, which limits the 'leave' path but does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the export feature, confirmation of an open/standard export format (e.g., iCalendar), evidence that the export covers all calendar data, and hands-on corroboration of a full migration away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Calendar data could be downloaded right away
wish the export tool worked for deactivated accounts
